item.text: {"action_type":"tool","claim_id":null,"hypothesis":"对任意二维实向量 u=(a,b)、v=(c,d)，猜想 (a²+b²)(c²+d²)=(ac+bd)²+(ad−bc)²；尚待实验与符号认证。","parent_id":null,"tool_name":"python_experiment","arguments_json":"{\"code\":\"from itertools import product\\nchecked = 0\\nfailures = []\\nresiduals = set()\\nfor a,b,c,d in product(range(-3,4), repeat=4):\\n    length_product = (a*a+b*b)*(c*c+d*d)\\n    dot_square = (a*c+b*d)**2\\n    area_square = (a*d-b*c)**2\\n    residual = length_product-dot_square-area_square\\n    residuals.add(residual)\\n    checked += 1\\n    if residual != 0:\\n        failures.append([a,b,c,d,residual])\\nresult = {'coordinate_range': [-3,3], 'checked': checked, 'residuals': sorted(residuals), 'counterexamples': failures[:10], 'counterexample_count': len(failures)}\",\"max_operations\":100000,\"timeout_seconds\":5}","evidence_ids":["EV001"],"decision_summary":"先枚举坐标在 −3 至 3 的整数向量对，探索候选平方关系并搜索反例；有限实验不作为全体实数的证明。","expected_information":"获得检查数量、差值集合及反例，为后续独立精确检查和符号认证提供依据。"}
